title: Why Big Smoke really turned on CJ in GTA San Andreas
subject: bigsmoke
description:
Did you trust Big Smoke the first time you played? 👇

Who Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris was, and why he sold out Grove Street. Spoilers for GTA San Andreas.

scenes.text: Big Smoke hugged CJ like a brother at his mother's funeral.
His real name was Melvin Harris, one of the OGs of Grove Street, next to Sweet and Ryder.
In 1992, CJ had flown home from Liberty City. Smoke was the calm one, the guy with a speech for every situation.
Sweet had one rule for the hood: no crack on Grove Street.
Smoke wanted the money that rule kept away.
So he made a deal with the Ballas and a crooked cop named Frank Tenpenny, and lost his oldest friends for it.
